name: Pum-Tech Korea Co., Ltd
summary: Pum-Tech Korea Co., Ltd engages in the manufacture and sale of plastic containers in South Korea and internationally. The company offers various products, such as zero stick, twist up and down refill, facial mist, eco tube, and point makeup applicator; skin care products, comprising cleansers/makeup removers, toners, lotions, serums, eye creams, creams, oils, sun care, and massage; base makeup products, including base/primer, foundation, and compact; point makeup products, contains blusher/highlighter, bronzer, lipstick, and tint/gloss/lip care; and functional products, such as mix, twist and mix, dual, and personalizing products.
